# jsmn

Pinned vendored copy of [jsmn](https://github.com/zserge/jsmn), a minimalistic
MIT-licensed JSON tokenizer by Serge Zaitsev. The copy is the header-only API
from upstream commit `25647e692c7906b96ffd2b05ca54c097948e879c`, with strict mode enabled by
`mcp-c` and a local bounds fix for truncated Unicode escape input.
